---
title: "Consolidation Status"
description: "Daily consolidation coverage: how many uploaded dates have been consolidated vs pending."
output: /data/consolidation_status.json
format: object
---

Overview of consolidation progress: total dates with uploads, how many have
been consolidated (have Parquets on IA), and the backlog depth.

```{sql}
WITH uploaded_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT date
  FROM manifest
  WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded'
),
daily_counts AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tribunal) FILTER (WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded') AS tribunals_uploaded
  FROM manifest
  WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded'
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_dates_with_uploads,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tribunals_uploaded >= 90) AS dates_fully_uploaded,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tribunals_uploaded < 90) AS dates_partially_uploaded,
  MIN(CAST(date AS VARCHAR)) AS earliest_date,
  MAX(CAST(date AS VARCHAR)) AS latest_date
FROM daily_counts;
```
